headline: SKM Egg Products shares investor call recording
summary: SKM Egg Products Export (India) Ltd has made the recording of its investor meetings held on October 23, 2026, available on its official website in compliance with SEBI regulations.

headline: Spice Money gets RBI nod as physical payment aggregator
summary: Spice Money, a subsidiary of DigiSpice Technologies, has received RBI approval to operate as a physical payment aggregator, subject to conditions set by the regulator.

headline: RailTel secures ₹20.04 crore deal with Munitions India
summary: RailTel Corporation of India has secured a ₹20.04 crore contract with Munitions India to set up data and disaster recovery centres for the Q-Shakti project.

headline: KEC International wins ₹2,872 crore PGCIL order
summary: KEC International secures ₹2,872 crore orders from PGCIL for 765 KV transmission lines supporting 8.5 GW renewable energy evacuation in Gujarat, marking the largest single order in India's T&D sector.

headline: Insecticides India fixes Nov 12 record date for interim dividend
summary: Insecticides (India) Limited will hold a board meeting on November 5, 2026, to consider an interim dividend for FY27. The record date for eligibility is fixed at November 12, 2026.

headline: Dr. Reddy's semaglutide relaunch on track for Nov 2026
summary: Dr. Reddy's semaglutide relaunch remains on schedule for November 2026, with FY27 volume guidance of 6-7 million pens maintained.

headline: Dr. Reddy's trims FY27 capex to ₹1,600-1,700 crore
summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories has lowered its FY27 capital expenditure guidance to ₹1,600-1,700 crore from ₹1,800 crore, citing project timing adjustments as the reason for the revision.

headline: Maruti Suzuki launches VICTORIS AURUM Edition
summary: Maruti Suzuki introduces the VICTORIS AURUM Edition Strong Hybrid to mark the model's record-breaking first year, featuring copper styling and a kit price of ₹22,990.

headline: Themis Medicare promoter pledges 15 lakh shares
summary: Vividhmargi Investments pledged 15,00,000 equity shares of Themis Medicare Ltd to CTL Trusteeship Limited on October 22, 2026, for personal borrowing.

headline: Ashoka Buildcon completes 47 km NHAI stretch
summary: Ashoka Buildcon receives provisional certificate for final 4.221 km of Karnataka highway, completing 47.196 km total. Annuity payments from NHAI continue.

headline: Swadeshi Industries promoter stake rises to 38.89%
summary: Promoter group acquires 52.10 lakh shares via preferential issue, increasing holding from 34.97% to 38.89%. Share capital doubles to 2.31 crore shares.

headline: DIC India tax adjustment reduced to ₹3.74 crore
summary: DIC India Ltd received a final income tax order for AY 2023-24 reducing the transfer pricing adjustment to ₹3.74 crore. The company plans to appeal the decision.

headline: Smriti Agrawal acquires 3.81% in Gallantt Ispat via gift
summary: Promoter group shareholder Smriti Agrawal acquired 91,98,700 equity shares of Gallantt Ispat Ltd on October 22, 2026, through an off-market gift transaction.

headline: Ugar Sugar shifts Q2FY27 board meet to Oct 27
summary: Ugar Sugar Works Ltd postponed its board meeting from October 26 to October 27, 2026, citing a state government meeting on cane prices. The board will approve Q2FY27 results.

headline: Bandhan Mutual Fund raises stake in EPL Ltd to 9.4%
summary: Bandhan Mutual Fund increased its holding in EPL Limited to 9.3993% after acquiring 65.47 lakh shares in the secondary market between September and October 2026.

headline: Deutsche Bank discloses ACC share encumbrance
summary: Deutsche Bank AG filed a disclosure regarding encumbrance over 106.45 million ACC shares held by promoter group entities, linked to a new facility agreement.

headline: Deutsche Bank discloses Ambuja Cements share encumbrance
summary: Deutsche Bank AG filed a SAST Reg 29(2) disclosure regarding encumbrance on 1.66 billion Ambuja Cements shares held by Endeavour entities to secure a new facility.

headline: Clarus Capital crosses 7% stake in Ador Welding
summary: Clarus Capital I and PAC ClearEdge LLC increased their combined holding in Ador Welding to 7.02% after acquiring 5,027 shares in the open market.

headline: Deutsche Bank discloses Orient Cement encumbrance
summary: Deutsche Bank AG disclosed a Regulation 29(2) filing regarding 149.29 million Orient Cement shares held as security by Ambuja Cements.

headline: Mangal Electrical to consider ESOP grants on Oct 31
summary: Mangal Electrical Industries Ltd board meeting scheduled for October 31, 2026, to approve employee stock option grants under the 2025 ESOP plan.

headline: Granules promoter sells 1.72 crore shares
summary: Dr Krishna Prasad Chigurupati sold 1.72 crore equity shares of Granules India on Sept 11, 2026. The revised SAST disclosure confirms the transaction via block and normal market sales.

headline: Seamec vessel off-hired due to technical breakdown
summary: Seamec Ltd's vessel SEAMEC SWORDFISH has been off-hired effective October 24, 2026, following a technical breakdown. The company is prioritizing repairs and will update on resumption.

headline: Sahajanand Medical receives DGGI summons on GST inquiry
summary: Sahajanand Medical Technologies received a summons from DGGI regarding a GST inquiry into reimbursements for clinical trials. The company states no material financial impact at this stage.

headline: Dolat Algotech sets record dates for CP redemption
summary: Dolat Algotech Limited announced November 2 and 5, 2026, as record dates for the redemption of two commercial paper tranches maturing in early November.

headline: Nukleus Office Solutions board meets Oct 31 for H1FY27 results
summary: Nukleus Office Solutions Limited scheduled a board meeting on October 31, 2026, to approve un-audited financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Granules promoter group stake rises to 37.39%
summary: Granules India promoter group acquired 2.49 crore shares via warrant conversion, lifting total holding to 37.39% of diluted capital.

headline: Orient Cement Q2FY27 Results: Net profit falls 41% QoQ
summary: Orient Cement reported a standalone net profit of ₹44 crore for Q2FY27, down 41% from the previous quarter. Revenue from operations declined 12% YoY to ₹565 crore.

headline: Dachepalli Publishers Q2FY27 results: PAT up 28% YoY
summary: Dachepalli Publishers Ltd reported a 28.4% YoY rise in net profit to ₹971 lakh for H1FY27. Revenue from operations grew 73.5% YoY to ₹7,001 lakh.

headline: Modis Navnirman Q2FY27 Results: PAT up 100.7% YoY
summary: Modis Navnirman Limited reported a 100.7% YoY rise in standalone net profit to ₹1,044.70 lakh for Q2FY27. Revenue from operations surged 83.3% to ₹6,938.32 lakh, driven by construction and redevelopment activities.

headline: SKP Securities Q2FY27 PAT falls 38% YoY
summary: SKP Securities reported a net profit of ₹182.53 lakh for Q2FY27, down 37.65% YoY. Revenue from operations declined to ₹1,010.70 lakh as brokerage income contracted.

headline: Oriental Rail targets ₹200 crore refurb orders by FY28
summary: Oriental Rail Infrastructure aims for ₹200 crore in refurbishment orders by FY28 from ₹800 crore tenders. Interior furnishing revenue is projected to hit ₹45-50 crore.

headline: PG Electroplast appoints Ruchika Bansal as director
summary: PG Electroplast's subsidiary NGM appointed Ruchika Bansal as independent director and replaced auditors with B S R & Co. LLP to align with parent company.

headline: Kotak Bank Q2FY27 PAT rises 26% to ₹5,645 crore
summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank reported a 26.3% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to ₹5,645 crore for Q2FY27. Interest income grew 15.4%, while NIMs remained stable.

headline: S V Global Mill Q2FY27: Standalone loss widens, consolidated profit surges
summary: S V Global Mill reported a standalone net loss of ₹63.53 lakh in Q2FY27, widening from the previous year. Consolidated profit jumped to ₹148.52 lakh driven by investment gains.

headline: Indian Bank appoints IRS officer as GOI nominee director
summary: Indian Bank appointed Manasa Gangotri Kata, an IRS officer of the 2007 batch, as Government of India nominee director effective October 23, 2026.

headline: Oswal Yarns Q2FY27: Loss widens to ₹4.11 lakh
summary: Oswal Yarns reported a standalone net loss of ₹4.11 lakh for Q2FY27, widening from ₹1.58 lakh in the year-ago quarter. Revenue from operations fell 10.9% YoY to ₹38.64 lakh.

headline: SBFC Finance Q2FY27: PAT rises 27% YoY
summary: SBFC Finance reported a 27.25% YoY rise in net profit to ₹1,388.74 million for Q2FY27. Interest income grew 35%, while GNPA improved to 2.64%.

headline: Kalpataru updates on LMG IPO over-allotment
summary: Kalpataru Projects International reports partial exercise of over-allotment option in Linjemontage IPO. KPTS holding stands at 66.45% after 1.87 lakh shares exercised.

headline: Sovereign Diamonds Q2FY27 loss widens to ₹62 lakh
summary: Sovereign Diamonds Ltd reported a net loss of ₹62.37 lakh for Q2FY27, widening from ₹57.08 lakh in Q1. Revenue from operations fell to ₹44.22 lakh.

headline: Cords Cable wins CGST appeal, ₹45.92 Cr demand set aside
summary: Cords Cable Industries received a favorable order from the CGST Commissioner (Appeals), Jaipur, setting aside a demand of ₹45.92 crore and penalties. The company confirmed no material impact on financials.

headline: Aqylon Nexus updates corporate website domain
summary: Aqylon Nexus Limited announced a change in its official website from www.aqylon.co to www.aqylonnexuslimited.com. The company has intimated both BSE and NSE regarding the update under SEBI regulations.

headline: JTL Defence Q2FY27: Revenue up 450%, loss widens
summary: JTL Defence Ltd reported a net loss of ₹263.12 lakh for Q2FY27 as revenue surged to ₹1,971.16 lakh. The company resumed operations post-CIRP, with auditor flags on pending recoveries.

headline: Tembo Global corrects preferential issue shareholding data
summary: Tembo Global Industries Ltd clarified errors in post-preferential shareholding details for three allottees, including Sanjay Patel Holdings and Fatema Kachwala.

headline: Lehar Footwears secures BIS license for general purpose shoes
summary: Lehar Footwears Limited has received BIS license approval for 'Shoes for General Purpose' under IS 17043: Part 2: 2024, enhancing product compliance.

headline: Vahh Chemicals invests ₹5 lakh in silicone JV
summary: Vahh Chemicals Limited approved a ₹5,00,000 investment for a 50% stake in V.Indus Silicone Technologies Private Limited. The move expands its footprint into silicone manufacturing and trading.

headline: Goyal Associates holds 32nd AGM, approves key appointments
summary: Goyal Associates Limited held its 32nd AGM on October 24, 2026, approving the re-appointment of directors and a shift in registered office location.

headline: Seshasayee Paper Q2FY27 Results
summary: Seshasayee Paper & Boards reported a 96% YoY jump in consolidated net profit to ₹42.31 crore for Q2FY27. Revenue rose 45% to ₹503.06 crore, driven by volume recovery.

headline: Riga Sugar CS resigns effective Oct 23
summary: Saurav Singh resigned as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of Riga Sugar Company Limited due to personal reasons. The resignation was accepted on October 23, 2026.

headline: Permanent Magnets Q2FY27 profit up 156% YoY
summary: Permanent Magnets Ltd reported a 156% YoY jump in net profit to ₹9.98 crore in Q2FY27, driven by strong EV demand and improved margins.

headline: JK Cement Q2FY27 PAT falls 35% QoQ; approves auditor change
summary: JK Cement reported Q2FY27 net profit of ₹190 crore, down 35% QoQ. Board approved Price Waterhouse as new statutory auditors and capex for JK Maxx Paints.

headline: Gujarat Ambuja Exports Q2 net profit jumps to ₹1.32B
summary: Gujarat Ambuja Exports reported a sharp rise in Q2 net profit to ₹1.32 billion from ₹381 million YoY, despite a slight dip in revenue.

headline: Chembond Q2FY27: Revenue up 32%, margins dip
summary: Chembond Chemicals reported 32% YoY revenue growth to ₹182.25 crore in H1FY27. However, EBITDA and PBT rose only 2% due to material cost volatility, causing margin contraction.

headline: AU Small Finance Bank Q2FY27 results
summary: AU Small Finance Bank reported a 53% YoY jump in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹858 crore. Interest income rose 24% as advances expanded significantly.

headline: Horizon Industrial Parks EVP-IT resigns
summary: Mitesh Vishnu Garg, Executive Vice President - IT at Horizon Industrial Parks, resigned effective October 31, 2026, to pursue new opportunities.

headline: VRL Logistics launches ₹280 crore buyback
summary: VRL Logistics opens a ₹280 crore buyback at ₹320 per share, offering a 32.88% premium. The tender offer runs from October 27 to November 2, 2026.

headline: Castrol India Q3FY26 revenue up 27%, EBITDA dips
summary: Castrol India reported 27% YoY revenue growth to ₹1,735 crore in Q3FY26. EBITDA fell 19% to ₹262 crore due to high raw material costs and currency headwinds.

headline: NECC Q2FY27: Net profit up 18% YoY
summary: North Eastern Carrying Corporation reported a 18.5% YoY rise in net profit to ₹215.42 lakh for Q2FY27. Revenue from operations grew 7.8% YoY to ₹7,627.40 lakh.

headline: SJ Corp Q2FY27: Consolidated profit ₹2.21 crore
summary: SJ Corporation Ltd reported a consolidated net profit of ₹2.21 crore for Q2FY27, driven by its rubber products subsidiary. The board declared an interim dividend of ₹0.05 per share.

headline: Apollo Micro Q2FY27: Net profit up 44% YoY
summary: Apollo Micro Systems reported a 44% YoY rise in standalone net profit to ₹4,773 lakh for Q2FY27. Revenue from operations grew 36% YoY to ₹3,063 crore.

headline: Kotak Bank appoints Anup Kumar Saha as MD & CEO
summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank appoints Anup Kumar Saha as MD & CEO effective Jan 1, 2027. RBI approval secured. Ashu Suyash re-appointed as Independent Director.

headline: Kotak Bank appoints Anu Aggarwal as SMP
summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank appointed Anu Aggarwal, President of Wholesale Banking, as Senior Management Personnel effective October 24, 2026.

headline: Paradeep Parivahan wins 10-year JSW Group contract
summary: Paradeep Parivahan secured a contract from JSW Group to deploy 100 electric trucks for bulk cargo transport, with a 10-year agreement and monthly cargo handling of around 125,000 MT.

headline: Venmax shareholders approve Hatri Pharma merger
summary: Venmax Drugs & Pharmaceuticals shareholders approved the scheme of amalgamation with Hatri Pharma Private Limited during an NCLT-mandated meeting held on October 24, 2026.

headline: Globe Civil faces IT prosecution for FY18 TDS delay
summary: Income Tax Dept filed prosecution complaint against Globe Civil Projects for FY2017-18 TDS delay. Matter pending in Delhi court; liability capped at ₹20 lakh.

headline: Dynamatic to spin off UAV unit via slump sale
summary: Dynamatic Technologies approves transfer of UAV vertical to subsidiary Dynauton via slump sale and preferential issue, raising ₹37.45 crore.

headline: Tijaria Polypipes approves 500 kWp solar project
summary: Tijaria Polypipes Limited board approved the installation of a 500 kWp rooftop solar power system at its factory premises in Jaipur, Rajasthan.

headline: Melstar subsidiary signs MoU for AP training hub
summary: Melstarr Aviations Tech Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Melstar Information Technologies, signed a non-binding MoU with the Andhra Pradesh Economic Development Board to establish a Maintenance Training Organization in Kurnool District.

headline: Lumax Auto Q2FY27: PAT up 46%, new mechatronics plant
summary: Lumax Auto Technologies reported a 46% jump in consolidated net profit to ₹11.67 crore in Q2FY27. The board approved a ₹150 crore capex for a new mechatronics facility in Haryana.
